podcast.body: A prominent track from the album of the same name, its evocative melodies were a key element sampled by Afrika Bambaataa for his foundational electro-hip hop track "Planet Rock." This track contributed significantly to the album's success and influence in popularizing machine-generated, danceable music. "le metió las evocadoras melodías de transduropexpress para crear Planet Rock, el tema afundacional del electro, ya sabéis, uno de los pilares del gig-hop."

srcs.episode: Por qué KRAFTWERK es la banda más influyente de la historia?

podcast.body: A sample from this song was notably used by Afrika Bambaataa in his highly influential 1982 track "Planet Rock." This use of sampling demonstrated Kraftwerk's lasting impact on genres like hip hop and electro. "and note the sample from craft works trans-Europe Express."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This 1977 hit by Kraftwerk exemplifies the electronic music and German krautrock that fascinated David Bowie by 1977. Their sound significantly influenced Bowie's "Berlin period," as he sought to discard his popstar persona and experiment with new musical directions. "This is there 1977 hit Trans-Europe Express."
